title: Phi Reader View site rule file
description: One file per site. The filename must be <site>.json.

site.description: Registrable domain, used only to match the filename.

host.description: Exact host (news.example.com), suffix wildcard (*.example.com, which also matches the bare host), or contains wildcard (*example*). Exact beats suffix beats contains.

pathPrefix.description: Restricts the rule to a path subtree. Matched on a / boundary, so /blog does not match /blogroll. A longer prefix wins over a shorter one.

pathContains.description: Restricts the rule to paths containing this substring. A prefix cannot express the shape a thread URL usually has, where the identifying part sits in the middle: /r/programming/comments/..., /naval/status/.... Without it a thread rule also fires on the subreddit listing and the home timeline, which are feeds. A rule with pathContains outranks one without.

content.description: Selectors for the article body. Every match of every selector is concatenated in document order, which is what makes articles split across sibling containers come out whole.

strip.description: Selectors removed from the extracted content.

expand.description: Selectors clicked before extraction, for read-more and show-comments style controls that hide part of the article.

title.description: Selector for the article title. Falls back to document.title.

thread.description: Present when the page is a thread rather than an article: a question and its answers, or a post and its comments. Each node `content` selects becomes its own post with a byline, instead of everything being concatenated into one run-on page. Every field below is either a selector run inside the post, or @name to read an attribute off the post element itself.

body.description: The post's text. Omit only when the container holds nothing but the body; otherwise the vote widgets and reply forms come too. A selector that matches nothing drops the post, so a stale selector makes the rule decline rather than producing junk.

author.description: Who wrote the post. Selector, or @name for an attribute (Reddit puts the author on the shreddit-comment element).

meta.description: Score, timestamp, or whatever else belongs beside the author. Selector or @name.

depth.description: Nesting depth of a comment tree, indented in the reader up to a fixed maximum. Selector or @name.

forceRung.description: Restricts extraction to a single rung. Use only when the other rungs produce a worse result than no result.

notes.description: Why this rule exists. Free text, ignored by the browser.
